nodes.n: Board headquarters, Delhi. A smaller room than the press conference. Three officials, one coffee each, and Kabir Sir in the corner.
"Vice-captain. For the World Cup. Karan asked for you specifically."

choice.d: One word. Papa would be proud of the brevity.

choice.t: "Give it to Vikrant. He's earned it."

nodes.t: Net three. I said don't make me regret it. You haven't. Yet.

nodes.n: Two hours later, a message from Vikrant: one word. "Chaiwala." Then another: "...Thank you."

msgs.t: Mehra's free. For now. He's bought two more franchises this week.
He will come for you again. I'll be watching when he does.
Mehra wants a deal. He'll give names for a shorter sentence.
The first name he gave me isn't from cricket. It's from the film industry.

nodes.n: Rajgarh. Your last evening before the World Cup camp. A boy with a taped bat and a tennis ball wrapped in electrical tape is waiting at the maidan.
He is maybe ten. He looks at you the way you once looked at a poster.

moment.title: The Kid
moment.desc: Gully rules. One tip, one hand. A ten-year-old with a taped ball wants to bowl you out. Survive three balls. Try not to look too pleased.
moment.loseSub: The whole maidan goes wild. He'll tell this story forever.

nodes.t: One season, you said. Three years ago. One season.

nodes.th: One more, Papa. Then one more after that.

nodes.cliff: Book 2 complete: capped, tested, unbought. The World Cup is next. Book 3 is coming soon.
Book 2 complete: series champion, unbought, the blue cap on your head. The World Cup is next. Book 3 is coming soon.

nodes.n: Two years later. 5:12 AM. The first bus to Meerut honks like it has been personally insulted.
You pour chai. A boy with a taped bat walks past, sees your face, and stops.

choice.t: "Come back at five. I'll bowl at you."

nodes.t: Glasses, beta. The Meerut bus is in four minutes.

nodes.cliff: Book 2 ends here, at the stall where it all began. Replay Episode 17 to run at ball three.
